    def stop_all(self):
        self.is_running = False
        # 停止所有线程
        for thread in self.threads:
            if hasattr(thread, "stop"):
                thread.stop()  # type: ignore
            thread.wait()  # 等待线程结束
        self.threads.clear()
        self.current_tasks.clear()
        # 清空任务队列
        with self.task_queue.mutex:
            self.task_queue.queue.clear()
